relationships.subject: CD34+/CD133+ endothelial progenitor cells
relationships.evidence_quote: increased CD34+/CD133+ cell counts were found to be significant (regression co-efficient β = −2.38, p = 0.012) predictors of improved exercise in EECP patients

relationships.subject: enhanced external counterpulsation
relationships.evidence_quote: Since mobilization of these precursors is believed to be stimulated by vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and stromal cell-derived factor-1 (SDF-1), which are upregulated by EECP

key_findings: EECP raised circulating CD34+/CD133+ (not CD34+/KDR+) cells, which predicted improved exercise capacity in refractory angina patients.
CD34+/CD133+ cells from EECP responders formed endothelial outgrowth colonies.
